A new Full Self-Driving build for AI4-equipped vehicles (initially in eligible regions) is expected to be released shortly, featuring new passive safety features.


Tesla AI (@Tesla_AI)

FSD Supervised v14.3.9 starting to roll out shortly

This release includes a new active safety feature set: FSD Supervised can now activate on your behalf when an imminent collision is detected and Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) may not be enough. 

It may also engage if we detect you’re heavily distracted or have accidentally disengaged FSD

For over a month now, we’ve been unsuccessful at resolving (or receiving an answer) as to why we’ve been ineligible to access @XMoney.

We’ve been a long-standing creator and also satisfy all of the Original Content Rewards Program requirements.

Any and all help is appreciated!
We’re hoping that someone at the @X, @SpaceX, or @SpaceXAI team can assist with this, and as always, we appreciate everyone’s continued support. ❤️🤞

Update! Only one X Money account is permitted per individual. This was not initially communicated when the service launched, and no recommendation was made to prioritize a creator account.

This has been escalated and hopefully we will have a resolution to share soon.

-  LOTS of new image assets
- “Hey Grok” in-cabin concierge

- En-route cabin remote (lights, music sync, Vault profile)

- Automated lost & found + referral coins

We also have some additional stuff that should go live later today! The excitement is real and the day has finally come for Cybercab, congrats to @Tesla for all the hard work in getting here! 🎉🥳
